scope: All local UI and frontend implementation slices in v4.1
purpose: Make design auditing and unbounded score-driven visual improvement autonomous while preserving the existing execution and design authority chain.

quality_target.score_formula: Sum 10 points for every component whose atomic checks are PASS.
quality_target.component_rule: A component earns 10 points only when every listed atomic check has candidate-bound evidence and no applicable DEVIATION, OMISSION, or UNVERIFIED remains.
quality_target.atomic_check_rule: Every check names applicability, source authority, observable acceptance criteria, observation method, and required evidence. A subjective summary cannot earn points without those fields.

severity_caps.unresolved_P0_or_P1: PASS is forbidden regardless of numeric score.
severity_caps.unverified_required_evidence: The affected component earns zero points and the audit remains non-PASS.
severity_caps.P3: In-scope P3 findings remain score-bearing and are never report-only.

candidate_binding.stale_evidence_rule: Evidence bound to another HEAD, commit tree, or worktree input snapshot is invalid and must not be reused.
candidate_binding.snapshot_inputs: The audit manifest lists every source and authority input path with its current SHA-256. The aggregate is computed from sorted '<sha256>  <path>\n' lines.

applicability.rendered_ui_requires: Full D0-D9 score loop, real browser captures, interaction and accessibility evidence.
applicability.non_rendering_requires: Candidate-bound source, authority, MengTo, contract-matrix, loop ledger, and provenance evidence; visual score components are NOT_APPLICABLE.
applicability.non_rendering_terminal: NOT_APPLICABLE with loop_state NON_RENDERING_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE. It is not a visual PASS and does not approve a rendered product surface.

re_audit_on: new screenshot or browser capability evidence

mengto.refresh_policy: Run at the start of every audit cycle and whenever repository structure, stack, or target surface changes.
not_allowed_in_audit_lane: generic font, token, motion, gradient, or image replacement that conflicts with repository authority

tooling.mengto_adapter: Record the exact recommendation command, adapter version/hash, exit code, and redacted output in mengto-recommendation.json.
tooling.browser_adapter: Record preview start, health check, four viewport captures, state/accessibility checks, browser version, and cleanup in capture-manifest.json.

lifecycle.name: candidate binding
lifecycle.success: All inputs are recorded for the same candidate and the snapshot manifest excludes audit outputs.
lifecycle.failure: UNVERIFIED and no design PASS is allowed.

lifecycle.name: MengTo pack selection
lifecycle.required_action: Run mengto-skills and record the recommendation output and selected pack.
lifecycle.success: Only the approved diagnostic and comparison lenses are active, and the recommendation artifact records router, command, version, and candidate binding.
lifecycle.failure: Use the last known pack only as a non-authoritative hint, mark selection UNVERIFIED, and prevent C10 from earning points until a fresh successful recommendation is recorded.

lifecycle.name: contract and static inspection
lifecycle.required_action: Compare implementation, tokens, primitives, states, and route structure to the bound design authority.
lifecycle.success: Static findings are classified before browser observation.
lifecycle.failure: Record the missing source or static capability; do not infer parity.

lifecycle.name: real-surface visual and interaction observation
lifecycle.required_action: Use a real browser surface for route, responsive, interaction, focus, overflow, and state evidence.
lifecycle.success: All applicable viewports and required states have candidate-bound evidence.
lifecycle.failure: NOT_RUN_BLOCKED when browser or target surface is unavailable. Mockups and stale screenshots are not substitutes.

lifecycle.name: finding classification
lifecycle.success: Every observed difference has source, evidence, impact, severity, owner, and iteration identity.
lifecycle.failure: The audit remains BELOW_TARGET until ambiguous findings are resolved or explicitly marked UNVERIFIED.

lifecycle.name: 100-point scorecard
lifecycle.required_action: Run all ten quality components and every applicable atomic check. Write scorecard.json with component status, points, source references, acceptance criteria, observation method, evidence IDs, baseline score, and target score.
lifecycle.success: The score is reproducible, equals the sum of atomic component points, and respects severity caps.
lifecycle.failure: Any score below 100 enters BELOW_TARGET and can never produce PASS.

lifecycle.name: mandatory improvement plan
lifecycle.required_action: Create improvement-plan.json before changing code. It must list every in-scope finding, ordered improvements, expected score delta, changed paths, acceptance criteria, and recheck evidence required.
lifecycle.success: A concrete plan exists for every unmet score component.
lifecycle.failure: No improvement plan means gate verdict FAIL with loop_state IMPROVEMENT_PLAN_REQUIRED; the implementation may not claim progress or PASS.

lifecycle.name: autonomous improvement application
lifecycle.required_action: Apply the improvement plan's safe local actions without routine user approval. There is no cycle-count limit; continue while score < 100 and no hard blocker exists. Every action records change_class, requires_owner_gate, owner_gate_id, authorization_artifact, and candidate snapshot.
lifecycle.success: Applied changes and actual changed paths are recorded against the plan, and owner-gated changes remain unapplied without authorization.
lifecycle.failure: Escalate authority, dependency, route, external-action, or scope changes to the existing owner gate.

lifecycle.name: full re-audit and rescore
lifecycle.required_action: Repeat D0 through D5 after every improvement change, including an uncommitted change, then return to D6 whenever score < 100.
lifecycle.success: A new score and score delta are bound to the new candidate; score 100 transitions to PASS_100.
lifecycle.failure: Score below 100 remains gate verdict FAIL with a non-terminal loop state; missing browser/source/owner capability becomes HARD_BLOCKED and NOT_RUN_BLOCKED. A no-progress iteration requires a named blocker or design decision packet.

lifecycle.name: 100-point design gate closeout
lifecycle.success: Score is exactly 100, all in-scope findings are resolved, all required viewport and accessibility evidence is current, and no hard blocker remains.
lifecycle.failure: Score below 100 is never a closeout. Keep the loop open or record NOT_RUN_BLOCKED for a named hard blocker. NON_RENDERING_PROVENANCE_COMPLETE closes only with NOT_APPLICABLE and cannot approve a UI release.

surface: loading, empty, error, disabled, hover, and active states
accessibility: chart text summary and table alternative

remediation.progress_invariant: Each iteration must increase score, close a finding, add required evidence, or produce a named owner/tool/design-decision blocker. This is a progress rule, not a cycle limit.
remediation.on_no_progress: Create design-decision.json or a hard-blocker object and stop with NOT_RUN_BLOCKED; never repeat a no-op plan silently.
approval_required_for: external API, secret, migration, deploy, push, merge, sharing, or destructive action
scope expansion beyond the assigned UI slice
remediation.on_score_target: PASS with score 100 and a complete recheck ledger
remediation.on_score_stall: FAIL with loop_state BELOW_TARGET; continue until progress occurs or a named blocker/design decision produces NOT_RUN_BLOCKED
remediation.on_hard_blocker: NOT_RUN_BLOCKED with the missing capability, owner action, and next allowed action
remediation.on_browser_unavailable: NOT_RUN_BLOCKED with the missing capability and next allowed action

required_artifacts: capture-manifest.json for RENDERED_UI or an explicit NOT_RUN_BLOCKED record
forbidden_claims: browser PASS without real route evidence
improvement applied without a subsequent full recheck
rendered UI PASS without capture-manifest and matrix evidence
owner-gated change applied without authorization artifact
no-progress iteration without blocker or decision packet

handoff.audit_to_implementation: Send an improvement plan for every score below 100 with source, evidence, expected score delta, changed paths, and acceptance criteria.
handoff.implementation_to_audit: Return the new exact HEAD/tree, changed-path list, applied plan ID, and actual score delta before full re-audit.
handoff.recheck_required_after: Any change that can affect layout, tokens, components, routes, accessibility, renderer, or responsive behavior.
handoff.user_prompt_policy: Do not ask the user for routine local audit, fix, recheck, or Wave progression. Preserve the existing explicit owner gates.

severity.P0: Core action inaccessible, severe route break, or accessibility blocker.
severity.P1: Major source-contract, responsive, interaction, or state deviation.
severity.P2: Material visual hierarchy, spacing, typography, surface, or consistency deviation.
severity.P3: In-scope visual polish gap that contributes to the 100-point target; it is not report-only.
